in_marathi.name: Anujaa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anujaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anujaa is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'anu' meaning grace, and 'jaa' meaning to be. The name signifies the one who is pleasing, graceful, and radiant.
